# Monocypher 4.0.2

X25519, Ed25519 (with its SHA-512) and BLAKE2b for the JSC host's
`crypto.subtle` and `node:crypto` (`node-crypto.inc`), the same code on every
OS. Unmodified from https://github.com/LoupVaillant/Monocypher/archive/refs/tags/4.0.2.tar.gz
(sha256 bc1ca30b1b2654e4e7daf2492c0d204200e55137f23fda6b7142fd7d523bd6b4):
`src/monocypher.{c,h}`, `src/optional/monocypher-ed25519.{c,h}` and
`LICENCE.md`. Dual-licensed: CC0-1.0 or BSD-2-Clause (see LICENCE.md).
